title: Selling and Promotion - Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA - Promotion: Advertising Media
subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which type of advertising media allows for localized targeting but typically suffers from a very short lifespan as it is often thrown away the next day?
questions.explain: Newspapers provide excellent local market penetration but are quickly discarded, meaning ads have a very short lifespan.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: A company wants to place a highly visual advertisement that reaches a specific, niche demographic (e.g., professional drone pilots) and remains in households for a month or more. The best media choice is:
questions.explain: Magazines offer high-quality color printing, target highly specific audiences based on interests, and are often kept by readers for weeks or months.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Advertising on the sides of city buses or in subway stations is classified as:
questions.explain: Transit advertising is a sub-category of out-of-home advertising located on or inside public transportation systems.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: What is the primary advantage of utilizing digital/online advertising compared to traditional print media?
options: Online ads cannot be skipped by consumers.
Online advertising provides instantaneous tracking of user clicks, engagement, and conversion metrics.
Online ads are completely free to produce and distribute.
Digital ads can only be seen on desktop computers.
questions.explain: A key advantage of digital advertising is trackability, allowing marketers to measure ROI, impressions, and click-through rates in real-time.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which media type uses items such as coffee mugs, pens, and calendars bearing a company's name or logo?
questions.explain: Specialty media (or promotional products) are relatively inexpensive, useful items given away for free carrying the company's branding.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: When scheduling radio advertisements, advertisers often target 'drive times'. What does this refer to?
options: The time when teenagers are learning to drive.
Late night hours when only long-haul truckers are listening.
Morning and late afternoon commute hours when radio listenership is at its peak.
The time of day when fast-food restaurants have drive-thru specials.
questions.explain: Drive time refers to the morning and evening rush hours when the vast majority of radio listeners are in their cars commuting to and from work.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which metric is commonly used in advertising to compare the cost-effectiveness of different media types by calculating the cost to reach 1,000 readers or viewers?
questions.explain: Cost Per Thousand (CPM), where 'M' is the Roman numeral for 1,000, is a standard metric used to calculate the cost to reach one thousand impressions.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: What is the primary drawback of using Direct Mail advertising (such as physical fliers or catalogs)?
options: It yields a very high response rate that overwhelms small businesses.
It is often viewed as 'junk mail' and discarded without being opened.
It is illegal in most municipalities.
It cannot be customized for the recipient.
questions.explain: A significant challenge with direct mail is low response rates, as many consumers perceive unsolicited physical advertisements as junk mail.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Pay-Per-Click (PPC) ads are strategies associated with which advertising medium?
questions.explain: SEO and PPC are fundamental strategies in digital or internet advertising, utilized on platforms like Google.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which broadcast medium uniquely allows advertisers to combine sight, sound, motion, and color to appeal to viewers' emotions?
questions.explain: Television provides a multi-sensory experience (sight, sound, motion) making it highly effective for emotional storytelling.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: In out-of-home advertising, a standard digital billboard rotating ads every 8 seconds is beneficial because:
options: It can be dynamically updated with new messaging quickly compared to printed vinyl.
It allows the company to mail the billboard to individual customers.
It forces drivers to stop and read the text completely.
It provides a personalized message for every unique driver.
questions.explain: Digital out-of-home media (like digital billboards) allow for real-time updates and rotation of advertisements without the physical labor of changing out printed materials.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA
